flags.why: The dirty or smeared sense in nhem nhuốc remains current, so archaic misleadingly labels ordinary modern usage.
Kì học commonly means an academic term or semester, a sense also used in [university admissions materials](https://cn.knu.ac.kr/download/gra_guide_vie2024-1.pdf).
flags.fix: Add as the first sense: noun | academic term; semester. Example: Kì học này tôi học năm môn. = I'm taking five subjects this semester.

flags.why: The example defines kì học instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Anh ấy nghiên cứu kì học và sưu tầm cờ các nước. = He studies vexillology and collects flags from different countries.

flags.why: Vía tốt means she is believed to bring good luck to others, whereas She is lucky describes her own luck.
flags.fix: She is believed to bring good luck, so everyone asks her to be the first customer of the year.

flags.why: The example defines cương thi instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Trong truyện, một con cương thi đuổi theo dân làng. = In the story, a reanimated corpse chases the villagers.

flags.why: Tương hỗ belongs to formal or technical language, so leaving it untagged misrepresents its suitability for casual conversation.
